subject: How Gut Microbes Drive Immune and Metabolic Failure in Spinal Discs
script: From Agewell Brief: How Gut Microbes Drive Immune and Metabolic Failure in Spinal Discs. A newly mapped gut-disc axis reveals how microbial metabolites and systemic inflammation reshape the spinal microenvironment to accelerate disc degeneration. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
